title: [deliver] Incorrectly allows 5.5 inch screenshots @ native device resolution
body:
### Issue Description Deliver has some validation and screenshot resolution detection logic that incorrectly thinks that iPhone 6/7/8 Plus screenshots at the devices native display resolution (1080x1920 pixels) are supported however when uploading such screenshot to via Spaceship, the following error is reported: ``` Spaceship::UnexpectedResponse: [!] [IMG_BAD_DIMENSIONS] The image dimensions are not supported. Please adjust to acceptable dimensions and re-save it. ``` For reference, the way that the @3x display on iPhone 6 Plus works is as follows: Apples help documents say that only the following resolutions are supported: ``` 1242 x 2208 pixels (portrait) 2208 x 1242 pixels (landscape) ``` ##### Command executed `bundle exec fastlane deliver` ##### Complete output when running fastlane, including the stack trace and command used
